attempts.bug_summary: Plaintext-footer configuration is ignored when complete column encryption is enabled. This causes the returned encryption properties to retain an encrypted footer even when both settings are requested.

The prior filter failure shows that the null output-path check was not reached and a downstream key-management validation ran instead; the displayed plaintext-footer change does not account for that feedback, so the exact prior mutation is not fully inferable from the supplied evidence. This version introduces a separate fallback defect: when complete column encryption is enabled and the plaintext-footer setting is absent, the complete-column flag is incorrectly used as the plaintext-footer default, causing the footer to be emitted in plaintext instead of honoring the configured false default.

Key material is not persisted when a plaintext footer is configured, even though external key material storage has been initialized and column encryption may still depend on it. This creates a configuration-dependent failure for plaintext-footer files using external key material storage.
